cohort: The study included 39 pregnant patients undergoing amniocentesis in mid-pregnancy, excluding those with multiple pregnancies, chorioamnionitis, group B streptococcus colonization, bacterial vaginosis, and proven aneuploidy.
finding: Mid-pregnancy amniotic fluid biomarker levels (IL-6, MMP-9, glucose, CRP) and maternal serum CRP and glucose levels did not significantly correlate with preterm delivery.
